question: What sum (in ₹) will earn a simple interest of ₹1,560 in 4 years at 20% per year rate of interest?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total simple interest in percentage over 4 years = 20% × 4 = 80%

This means 80% of Principal = ₹1560

⇒ Principal = (1560 ÷ 80) × 100

⇒ Principal = 19.5 × 100 = 1950

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1950.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
• Year 0 Year 4 P = ? Rate = 20% p.a. Simple Interest = ₹1560 Time = 4 Years 
 

**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹1560

Rate (R) = 20% per year

Time (T) = 4 years

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ 1560 = (P × 20 × 4) ÷ 100

⇒ 1560 = (P × 80) ÷ 100

⇒ 1560 = P × 0.8

⇒ P = 1560 ÷ 0.8

⇒ P = 1950

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1950.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest vs Compound Interest

Simple Interest (SI) is calculated solely on the initial principal, whereas Compound Interest (CI) is calculated on both the principal and the accumulated interest from previous periods.

Amount Formula

Total amount accrued under Simple Interest = P + SI = P + (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Compound Interest Formula

The amount under Compound Interest is calculated as A = P × (1 + R÷100)T and the Compound Interest is CI = A − P.
